flow.name: Genesy Flow
flow.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Log in again to carry on.
flow.chooseWorkspaceText: The workspace you used last is no longer available to you.
flow.noWorkspace: You are not in any workspace yet
flow.noWorkspaceText: Ask an admin of your account to invite you.
flow.assistantOffText: It is not switched on for this environment yet.
flow.assistantNotReadyText: It is switched on but its setup is not complete. Try again later.
flow.conversationLater: Conversations with the assistant arrive here in a later release.

storefront.title: Storefront design
storefront.intro: Review saved revisions before publishing changes to your shop.
storefront.publishText: This revision will replace the published home page. The previous revision remains available to restore.
storefront.restoreTitle: Restore this revision as a draft?
storefront.restoreText: This creates a new draft. Your published shop stays unchanged until you publish it.
storefront.restoredDone: Revision restored as a new draft.
storefront.conflict: The storefront changed. Select a revision to refresh its preview and review it again.
storefront.unsupported: This revision cannot be previewed with the available components.
storefront.noAccess: Only workspace owners and admins can review the storefront.
storefront.loggedOut: Log in again to see the preview.

chat.resultsEmptyText: Ask about sales, orders, stock or an invoice. Charts and lists appear on this side while you talk.
chat.reviewPending: An action is waiting for your approval
chat.officeSignIn: Office opens in a new tab. You may need to sign in to Office separately, and check that Office shows the same workspace.
chat.officeNotLinked: Office is not linked from Flow here. Open Office yourself to finish this.
